# 🥳 CozyUI Ex，CozyUI+的非官方扩展资源包

**English** | [简体中文](https://github.com/WhatDamon/cozyui-ex/blob/main/README_ZHCN.md)

![封面](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/jrC5r3Mp/images/37ebbcdd5ee29548fd194f5e292258055825afa7.png)

![GitHub仓库星标](https://img.shields.io/github/stars/WhatDamon/cozyui-ex?style=for-the-badge&logo=github) 
[![最后提交](https://img.shields.io/github/last-commit/WhatDamon/cozyui-ex?style=for-the-badge&logo=github)](https://github.com/WhatDamon/cozyui-ex/commits/main/) 
[![自动打包状态](https://img.shields.io/github/actions/workflow/status/WhatDamon/cozyui-ex/autopack.yml?style=for-the-badge&label=autopack%20build&logo=github)](https://github.com/WhatDamon/cozyui-ex/actions/workflows/autopack.yml) 
[![Modrinth下载量](https://img.shields.io/modrinth/dt/cozyui-ex?style=for-the-badge&logo=modrinth)](https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/cozyui-ex) 
![Modrinth关注者](https://img.shields.io/modrinth/followers/cozyui-ex?style=for-the-badge&logo=modrinth) 
![Modrinth版本](https://img.shields.io/modrinth/v/cozyui-ex?style=for-the-badge&logo=modrinth&label=modrinth%20latest)

> ⚠️ 警告！！！
>
> 仍在开发中，部分细节可能处理得不够完善，还请见谅😥！
>
> **本项目已暂停更新。** [了解更多](https://github.com/WhatDamon/cozyui-ex/discussions/11)。

> 请记住，**首先下载[CozyUI+](https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/cozyui-plus)**，然后按以下方式加载此资源包……
>
> ![示例](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/jrC5r3Mp/images/c7e8d2e10416e33d8a8c35121849be9b9f1e366d.png)
>
> 除非你喜欢糟糕的体验。

此资源包将CozyUI+扩展到更多模组，同时也支持愚人节快照专属的GUI（例如25w14craftmine）。

## ⬇️ 下载

你可以在[Modrinth](https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/cozyui-ex)下载本资源包的最新版本！*（推荐）*

想要更*夜版*的体验？点击[此处](https://nightly.link/WhatDamon/cozyui-ex/workflows/autopack/main/)获取自动打包版本！

## 🖊️ 额外支持

请参阅：https://github.com/WhatDamon/cozyui-ex/wiki/Extra-Support

## ❓ 常见问题

请参阅：https://github.com/WhatDamon/cozyui-ex/wiki/FAQ
